title: Evolution of carbon emission efficiency in the construction industry: evidence from Guangdong-Fujian-Zhejiang coastal urban agglomeration in China
core_idea: Develop an evaluation framework for carbon emission efficiency of the construction industry (2013–2022) in the Guangdong-Fujian-Zhejiang coastal urban agglomeration using an unexpected-output slack-based measure model, applying data envelopment analysis for static distribution and the Malmquist productivity index for dynamic evolution, to inform synergistic carbon reduction strategies and coordinated regional low-carbon development.
tldr: The study aims to assess temporal and spatial evolution of construction-sector carbon emission efficiency in the Guangdong-Fujian-Zhejiang urban agglomeration (2013–2022) using a slack-based DEA approach and Malmquist productivity analysis to support coordinated, cross-regional low-carbon strategies.
